in_urdu.name: دارول
in_urdu.meaning: دارول کا مطلب ہے رہائش کا گھر یا ٹھکانہ

data.cultural_impact: The term 'Darul' has been used throughout Islamic history to describe various types of physical spaces revered in the Islamic culture. For instance, a Darul Islam is a political state where Islamic law prevails, while a Darul Salaam is a city of peace where Muslims live in accordance with Islamic principles. Moreover, Masjid al-Haram (The Grand Mosque) in Mecca and Masjid al-Nabawi (The Prophet's Mosque) in Medina are known as Darul Hajj (The Place of Pilgrimage), welcoming millions of pilgrims every year. These places carry immense importance not only for Muslims but also for the broader Islamic civilization.
data.spiritual_significance: More importantly, Darul refers to a spiritual sanctuary where one can find refuge from the trials and tribulations of life and seek nearness to God. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Allah's Apostle said, "There are nine kinds of occasions when invocation (du'a) is due: When you enter your home, when you take bath, when you put on pretty garments (i.e., after dressing up), when you take off them (i.e., after taking off), when you mount a ride (i.e., a mount), when you embark on a journey, when you lie down in your bed and when you take food (i.e., at the beginning of a meal)." (Bukhari).
